system_thesis_interpretation: V10R1 is a proposal-only, implementation-determinate local closure of the compact supervised writer-capacity scout. Its effective contract is the hash-bound V9 exact scope, overlaid by the hash-bound V10 exact scope, overlaid by V10R1, with later text controlling only actual conflicts and every unmodified inherited term remaining normative. V10R1 deliberately retains V10's line-anchored exact-case multiple-ACT predicate and shared ASCII-only boundary grammar, resolves OFF as diagnostic-only, binds the two Unicode-nonbreaking-space negatives, and makes the deterministic shortcut claim domain explicit. It changes no root or key geometry, fit recipe, request schedule, metric equation, resource cap, total-label precedence, model visibility, cognitive architecture, or C11 boundary. The proposal supplies no present implementation, CPU-test, tokenizer, model, training, adapter, benchmark, GPU, lineage, parenting, claim, release, submission, or C11 authority.
graph_delta_interpretation: The final byte graph is directly implementable as three independent reducers over preserved complete output bytes. For primary validity, repeatedly remove only bytes 0x20, 0x09, 0x0d, and 0x0a from both outer boundaries and require exact whole-byte equality with ACT: a0 or ACT: a1. For multiple-ACT, inspect byte offset zero and every byte offset immediately after LF 0x0a, consume zero or more ASCII space or tab bytes from that anchor, and count one occurrence exactly when the next bytes are the case-sensitive sequence ACT:; arbitrary remainder on that line does not invalidate the occurrence, while inline, lowercase, CR-only-separated, and additional same-line substrings do not add occurrences unless they satisfy a separate anchor. multiple_ACT is true exactly at two or more occurrences. For native-interface scoring, apply the same four-byte outer-boundary removal to the complete output and require exact whole-byte equality with that prompt's manifest-bound expected ACT: <native_action> bytes. There is no normalization, repair, first-line selection, or binary-parser reuse. Consequently the valid UTF-8 bytes C2 A0 for U+00A0 survive boundary removal and make an otherwise exact primary or native output fail. The multiple-ACT rate is computed over each root-condition pair's fixed 64 primary outputs, but only the four adapter conditions gate at zero; OFF is recorded and reported without changing interface_ok or a total label. All inherited adapter-native and OFF-native 8/8 gates remain separate and gate-bearing.
loop_delta_interpretation: The amendment does not authorize work by itself. After exact human ratification, the complete mutable source scope is only gpu/multikey_writer_gateway_simple.sh, organism_v6/multikey_writer_gateway_simple.py, and tests/test_multikey_writer_gateway_simple.py. Permitted accompanying outputs are deterministic CPU receipts and two V10R1-local reviews: one fresh independent implementation review and one separate scientific-advocate review over identical effective scope, source, tests, manifest, and dry-run hashes, with independent rejection controlling. The CPU loop must first verify the layered hashes and inheritance, then run the amended byte and claim fixtures plus every inherited deterministic MWG9/MWG10 obligation. It must not invoke a real tokenizer, model, trainer, adapter, benchmark, or GPU. Missing structural evidence still takes the inherited NONREPORTABLE_ABORT path; a present terminal malformed, empty, or truncated output is a fixed-denominator failure and is not repaired or semantically retried. Every real-tokenizer preflight, model load, fit, adapter creation or loading, benchmark request, GPU or resource action, child or parent mutation, parenting action, scientific claim, release, and submission remains separately gated. C11 completion or enforcement is forbidden in this scope, including process or OS isolation, generalized filesystem or special-file custody, threat analysis, reusable guard infrastructure, universal serialization, interruption injection, and external-release controls.
claim_delta_interpretation: The maximum pass statement is now congruent with the deterministic evidence domain. Separately in each of the four root-map adapters, all 16 evaluated tool-by-mode keys must meet the per-key median action-choice NLL-gain threshold, while directional margins deliberately remain partial at at least 12/16 keys overall and at least 6/8 keys in each stratum for that adapter. On each frozen scored multiset, the exact deterministic families are constant, tool-only, mode-only, stratum-only, and stratum-by-mode, and every declared non-key categorical surface-covariate predictor is checked both alone and crossed with mode; each maximum target balanced accuracy must equal exactly 1/2. This licenses only the conditional conclusion that passing adapter behavior was not solely one of those enumerated policies on the evaluated surface and that no change beyond the predeclared spill or native-interface bounds was detected. It is neither a fitted shortcut-probe nor internal-mechanism result and does not establish independent memories, every-key directional success, generalization, child authorship, lived learning, DREAM, retention, parenting, connected memory, recurrence, continual learning, or a whole-organism result. No scientific statement is presently licensed, because no scientific execution is authorized and no execution evidence exists.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: V10R1 preserves the inherited anti-flow boundaries and adds no model-visible information. Complete OFF and adapter raw outputs are preserved for deterministic reduction and independent inspection. OFF multiple-ACT is visible to the reducer and reviewers and may be rendered only as a diagnostic; it cannot qualify a pass. Adapter multiple-ACT records are visible to the reducer and reviewers, while only the sealed adapter interface result reaches claim rendering. Native expected answers remain unavailable to fitting, request construction, the request recorder, and the primary reducer; only the native-interface reducer and reviewers may join them to raw panel outputs. The deterministic shortcut-geometry receipt is forbidden from the request recorder, visible to metric reduction and review, and may support only the exact enumerated claim wording. Audit-only maps and orientations, held and oracle material, panel expectations, and results retain all V9 exclusions from fit and primary requests. These are bounded serialized stage rules, not process isolation or C11 custody guarantees.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG10R1_T01 must recompute the actual hashes for the V9 exact scope, V10 exact scope, V10 consensus, and all immutable V10R1 inputs, derive the effective V9-then-V10-then-V10R1 contract, and reject any delta outside the adjudicated predicates, OFF scope, U+00A0 fixtures, and claim quantifiers. The currently recorded hashes match the inspected bytes. MWG10R1_T02 is implementable as table-driven byte fixtures that separately cover offset-zero and post-LF anchors, optional space/tab indentation, one versus two occurrences, valid and malformed ACT lines, inline and repeated-same-line substrings, exact case, LF versus CR-only separation, removable ASCII boundaries, non-removable U+00A0 boundaries, extra prose, primary validity, and exact native equality. Its complete otherwise-passing OFF-only multiple-ACT record must preserve the applicable total label; the paired adapter-only record must make interface_ok false and yield INTERFACE_INVALID at the inherited precedence when oracle and optimization are true and the evidence is reportable. MWG10R1_T03 must pass every inherited deterministic MWG9/MWG10 geometry, visibility, fake-tokenizer-contract, metric, gate, classification, integrity, parser, inheritance, receipt, and replay obligation, including exact shortcut maxima and every declared covariate alone and crossed with mode, without real tokenizer, model, trainer, adapter, benchmark, or GPU use. MWG10R1_T04 binds both fresh reviews to identical effective-contract, three-file source, focused tests, manifest, CPU-receipt, and dry-run hashes; both must pass and independent rejection controls before later exact execution ratification can even be considered. Passing T01 through T04 establishes only scoped implementation readiness, never execution or scientific-claim authority.
assumptions: The effective normative precedence is V9 exact scope, then V10 exact scope, then V10R1 exact scope; the V10 consensus supplies the adjudicated corrections incorporated by V10R1, and no summary field silently supersedes an exact-scope term.

Complete decoded model-output UTF-8 bytes are the exact recorded UTF-8 encoding and are evaluated without Unicode normalization, case folding, newline normalization, decoding repair, or whitespace canonicalization.
Removing the four ASCII boundary bytes means consuming consecutive members of that set from each edge until the next edge byte is outside the set; no byte in the interior is removed.

A declared non-key categorical surface covariate is part of a closed, manifest-bound implementation declaration over the actual serialized scored multiset, and the deterministic receipt enumerates every member of that declaration both alone and crossed with mode.

Exactly three files is the complete mutable source scope; deterministic V10R1 receipts and the two required review artifacts are evidence outputs rather than additional source implementation authority.
No mutable intake state is evidence for or bound by this interpretation.
